label: Blind sample null 036: intact forest, no Hansen loss 2001-2023, tile 60N_100E

verdict.headline: No real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.00 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2020 (90% interval −0.02 to +0.01). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 23 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.39). Counted by gap size instead, 24 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.41). The interval rules out a meaningful change beyond what the controls did.
reasons: a change of at least 0.05 in greenness (NDVI) is ruled out by the interval

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
